display.purpose: Page and hero headings. Inter 700, modest clamp ceiling — clinical, not a poster.

title.purpose: Card titles, dish names, section headers. Inter 600.

body.purpose: All prose. Inter 400, 16px min on mobile, 60-75ch measure.

label.purpose: Chip text, eyebrows, meta. Inter 600, 0.06em, often uppercase.

data.purpose: Macros, calories, prices, order IDs. JetBrains Mono 500, tabular-nums. Its scarcity is the clinical signal.

serif.purpose: Rare editorial accent headings only. Instrument Serif. Never body or UI.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Popovers and dropdowns above the canvas.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets rising from the screen edge.

shadows.name: saffron-glow
shadows.purpose: The floating add-button only — the one earned colored glow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one saffron action. Exactly one per screen. Dark-ink label, never white.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFD75A 0%, #fbbf24 60%); color: #402d00; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), filter 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #402d00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Surface fill, hairline border, primary-text label.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 12px; background: #1f1f1f; color: #e2e2e2; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms, transform 120ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #2a2a2a; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fbbf24; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Fully-rounded glass pill for filters and category nav. Saffron-tinted when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: #c6c6c7; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fbbf24; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip--on { background: color-mix(in srgb, #fbbf24 14%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #fbbf24 42%, transparent); color: #fbbf24; }

components.name: Themed Select
components.description: Native select themed as a chip — strips OS chrome, adds a Phosphor caret, keeps the mobile wheel picker.
components.css: .ds-selchip { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-select { appearance: none; height: 34px; padding: 0 28px 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #c6c6c7; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fbbf24; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-selcaret { position: absolute; right: 11px; pointer-events: none; color: #c6c6c7; }

components.name: Macro Ribbon
components.description: The signature clinical readout — macros in JetBrains Mono, tabular figures, stated units. Whole numbers only.
components.html: KCAL420PROTEIN32gCARBS38gFAT14g
components.css: .ds-ribbon { display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: #1f1f1f; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-rc { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-rl { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #9c8f79; } .ds-rv { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #e2e2e2; } .ds-rv--sf { color: #fbbf24; } .ds-rv i { font-style: normal; font-size: 11px; color: #9c8f79; }

components.css: .ds-dcard { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 180px; border-radius: 16px; background: #1f1f1f; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); overflow: visible; } .ds-dimg { position: relative; height: 120px; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2a2a2a, #1b1b1b); } .ds-fssai { position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 8px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 2px solid #4F7D5A; border-radius: 3px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #131313; } .ds-fssai span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #4F7D5A; } .ds-addb { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -12px; transform: translateX(-50%); height: 30px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #fbbf24; color: #402d00; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px color-mix(in srgb, #fbbf24 32%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms; } .ds-addb:active { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.96); } .ds-addb:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e2e2e2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dbody { padding: 18px 12px 12px; } .ds-dname { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: #e2e2e2; } .ds-dmeta { margin-top: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(226,226,226,0.5); } .ds-price { color: #fbbf24; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Tanmatra is a clinical wellness storefront that reads like a well-lit kitchen after dark: a deep near-black canvas, one warm saffron light that marks every action, and a disciplined monospace layer that makes nutrition numbers feel measured rather than marketed. The signature theme is dark. The mood is credible, precise, calm, and human. It rejects the sterile hospital-EMR look, the alarmist red-everywhere wellness-app look, and the trend-driven supplement-brand gradient look. The palette is layered: a Clinical-Dark base provides the token foundation, and the Nocturnal Nourishment (NN) layer — the .tnm2 skin — governs every live customer money-path surface. Saffron #fbbf24 is the single unified action color across both.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default; deep near-black canvas, warm off-white text.
Exactly one accent — saffron — and exactly one primary action per screen.
A monospace clinical layer (JetBrains Mono) reserved for numbers, so data reads as measured.
Token-only color; raw hex is a lint-blocking defect.
Safety information (FSSAI marks, allergens) is exempt from minimalism and always shown.

rules.name: The One Saffron Rule
rules.body: Saffron is the only accent that marks action. If two things on a screen are saffron, one is not really the primary action — demote it. Cyan and sage never stand in as a second CTA color.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: A .tnm2 (customer) surface draws canvas, text, and alerts from --color-nn-*; a base Tailwind surface draws from --color-ink-* / --color-*-theme. Never hardcode one layer's canvas hex (#0b0c0e) onto the other layer's surface (#131313). Consume the token; the skin resolves it.

rules.name: The No-Legacy Rule
rules.body: Gold #D4AF37 and blue #6BA3C8 are retired, absent from the codebase, and must never return. Saffron and cyan only.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is forbidden for headings, body, navigation, and marketing copy. It appears only on numbers and codes. Diluting it dilutes the clinical signal.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every price and every numeric column uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Figures must not jitter as they change.

rules.name: The No-Third-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter, JetBrains Mono, Instrument Serif. A serif display for body or UI was evaluated and rejected; do not reintroduce one.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: On dark, hierarchy is the surface step and the hairline, not the shadow. Never rely on a drop shadow alone to separate a card from the canvas.

rules.name: The In-Place Rule
rules.body: Variant, protein, and quantity changes swap in place under 100ms with zero navigation. A full page reload on a variant change is a defect.

dos: Do source every color from a token and run lint:colors; a raw hex, rgb(), or arbitrary Tailwind color in src is a blocking defect (only index.css and theme.css are exempt).
Do use saffron #fbbf24 (--color-nn-primary / --action) as the single primary action, exactly one per screen.
Do render every macro, calorie, price, and code in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums and stated units (g, kcal).
Do give every interactive .tnm2 control the 2px saffron :focus-visible ring — a missing ring is a known past defect, equal to a lint failure.
Do carry the FSSAI veg/non-veg marks (>=14px) on every dish card, dish page, cart line, and order line, and keep allergens always-visible on the dish page.
Do trace every money figure to a server quote and format with Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN'); the client displays, it never computes.
Do reserve final dimensions on every image, card, and skeleton (CLS <= 0.05); the shell renders first — no route paints blank.
donts: Don't use legacy gold #D4AF37 or legacy blue #6BA3C8. They are retired and absent; saffron and cyan are the only brand accents.
Don't hardcode the Clinical-Dark canvas (#0b0c0e) or bone text (#f2f0e9) on a live .tnm2 surface — those use --color-nn-bg (#131313) and --color-nn-on-surface (#e2e2e2).
Don't use cyan #34daff as a CTA or a decorative glow; it is a tertiary data highlight only.
Don't use sage as an unrestricted decorative green; it means verified / healthy / approved.
Don't set JetBrains Mono on headings, body, navigation, or marketing text; its scarcity is the clinical signal.
Don't render false macro precision (23.47g protein) — whole numbers only, honest to kitchen variance.
Don't hide allergen or FSSAI information behind hover, accordion, or tap; safety is exempt from progressive disclosure.
Don't render silent hardcoded fallback data on a failed fetch; show honest error microcopy.
Don't reach for a modal as the first thought, a display font in a UI label, or a serif for body/headings.
Don't ship the AI tells: no colored side-stripe borders, no gradient text, no ghost card (1px border + heavy shadow), no over-rounded cards (>16px), no decorative eyebrow above every section.
